integrity: The result is proved by a direct support classification for the bivariate polynomial and an explicit inverse for the ordinary domination polynomial; primary-source statements were compared against the final claim. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Polynomial injectivity is asserted only inside the class of connected complete multipartite graphs.
The theorem does not imply global domination uniqueness against arbitrary non-multipartite graphs.
Finite exhaustive checking is corroborative rather than a proof of the all-orders statement.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently phrased or non-indexed prior reconstruction theorem.
title: Domination-polynomial rigidity of complete multipartite graphs
